Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the sale of milk at small dairies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to direct sales of milk; and adding a new sectionto chapter 15.36 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 15.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) This chapter does not apply to milk sold directly to theconsumer at the premises where produced if: (a) The milk is produced on a small scale farm; and (b) The milk is not advertised for sale. (2) As used in this section, "small scale farm" means a locationwhere there are no more than two producing dairy cows, nine producingsheep, or nine producing goats on the premises where milk is produced.
